feature: Live document share links — review/purchasing (Phase 2 of Epic #660 Share & Export)
notes: GIT #1044 (sub-issue of Epic #660, via #660's own build-plan comment). quick_win_result_shares and any other old share mechanism are DEPRECATED for this feature and are not exercised here.

NEW SURFACE COVERED: POST /api/portal/live-documents/share (live-document-shares.ts) — mints a liveDocumentSharesTable token for the caller's own document set, in either variant. GET /api/public/live-document-shares/:token (same file) — no-auth, token-gated read of the live document set: pillar scores/stats/findings + AI narrative for every report in both variants, plus the SOW's real priced scope (via runSalesOfferEngineForTenant, same authority /portal/assessment/recommended-offers uses) in the purchasing variant only.

Also asserts the review variant does NOT carry an `offers` key at all (no pricing/commercial terms leak into that variant's response), and that an unknown/garbage token 404s and a revoked token is unreachable (structurally — this manifest cannot revoke a link itself without a DB write, so revocation is asserted at the schema/route level via code review, not exercised live here).

WHAT THIS MANIFEST DOES NOT ASSERT: the DocumentExportMenu.tsx UI click-through (minting via the real menu) — the two share MenuItems carry no data-testid, matching the same precedent live-document-pdf-export.json (#1043) already set of testing this menu's wiring via API contract rather than a menu click; also does not assert PDF/visual rendering of the new /shared-live-documents/:shareToken page (manual spot-check), and does not assert narrative PROSE content (Anthropic output is non-deterministic) — only that the endpoint returns a well-formed `sections` array per report.

ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL, TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD (same designated testbed Assessment account every other copilot-readiness manifest uses).

NOT YET RUN LIVE this session: this route only exists in this session's own worktree commit, and shaneapp://runTest executes against the DEPLOYED Replit origin (per CLAUDE.md's shaneapp-runtest-hits-deployed-build-not-worktree note) — same expected-red class #1041/#1042/#1043's own manifests document until Shane redeploys. SHANE TO-DO: run the manual SQL migration (lib/db/migrations/manual/2026-08-14-live-document-shares-1044.sql), then redeploy api-server (new routes) and msp-portal (DocumentExportMenu wiring + new public page) — once deployed, run this manifest for a real pass/fail.

apiTests.name: SETUP — log in as the designated testbed Assessment account to obtain a real bearer; extract it as {{authToken}}
POST /api/portal/live-documents/share {variant: review} mints a real token and a copyable shareUrl.
GET /api/public/live-document-shares/{{reviewToken}} — no Authorization header at all, proving the token itself is the credential.
The review variant carries the live pillar report set — real findings/scores, no pricing.
The review variant's response has NO offers key at all — no pricing/commercial terms leak, per this issue's own explicit requirement.
POST /api/portal/live-documents/share {variant: purchasing} mints a second, independent token.
GET /api/public/live-document-shares/{{purchasingToken}} — purchasing variant additionally carries the SOW's real priced offers (runSalesOfferEngineForTenant, reused unmodified).
An unrecognized token is refused (404), not silently rendered as an empty set.
POST /api/portal/live-documents/share with no bearer is rejected — same requireAuth contract as every other tenant-scoped portal route.
POST /api/portal/live-documents/share with an invalid variant is rejected (400) — proves the variant enum is enforced server-side, not just by the client's own two menu items.
